content: She looked at them, her eyes starting to well with tears. `”Yeah. Why wouldn’t I be?”` She then buried her face in her hands again.
`Maybe the tears. Maybe because you look like Sab did when getting stressed over the whole corpse thing.`
She tried to wave it off, but… `”He left..”` She looked back at them. `”He left, and didn’t come back.”`

`Busy, maybe?`
they collapse suddenly like a puppet with its strings cut, only to pop up again a moment later. `[expletive] that made me almost black out. Alright, can't talk with Sab for long in this state, but she says last she saw him was a few hours back, got recruited to go help in the Noir.`

`”He didn’t even say goodbye!”` At this, the waterworks began. Tears rolled down her cheeks as she got up. `”We fell asleep watching the stars, then he just ups and bolts without saying anything!”` As she spoke, her voice steadily grew louder and louder. `”We were having the perfect night! He all but admitted he finds me attractive, but then he won’t even say goodbye?! I love him! How can I be sure he feels the same?!!` She then collapsed on the bed, screaming into her pillow: `”Maybe I shouldn’t even [expletive] try!!!”`

`The sudden leaving, did he know you were awake? If not, could've been not wanting to wake you up but needing to go help with stuff. And, well, judging what I saw, maybe he just thought it was awkward? Iunno.`
ignoring the pain from their head, they fly over closer to Secel.

She lay there, sobbing into the pillow. `”I thought he was the one.. No, he **was** the one. He was the only one! And now I don’t know if he even cares!”` She then dug her fingers into the pillow, still sobbing.
they think for a few.
`Listen. I can't guarantee answers from this. But I know I told Sab about your date plans. And she also got dragged into the Noir stuff earlier.`
`You want me to ask her if she happened to ask him how it went?`
`”Fine…”` She rolled over a little to look at him. `”If she knows, I’d like to hear it..”`

`Got it. Just a warning, might take a little bit. Please don't be alarmed.`
they collapse again onto the bed.
`”Is… there anything I can do to help you with that?”` She asked, putting a hand on their head.
there's a faint flicker of movement, but nothing else, until - they suddenly spring back up.
`So I got good news and bad news. What'd you want first?' their voice sounds slightly flickery.
`”I’ve just had the probably worst date I’ll ever have. Bad news.`

`He didn't say anything to Sab about leaving, last thing he said about it was falling asleep with you. Could be more neutral news though, because if it was really bad he'd have mentioned it or asked to not talk about it, right?`
`Now, for the good news. You wanna know what he did say about it?`
`Guess mentioning it's good news is a slight spoiler, but hey.`
`”I guess…”` She sighed, and rolled over. `”Spit it out.”`
`And I quote, 'It was a wonderful evening and I hope we both enjoyed it'.`

`So with all this evidence I'm willing to conclude that either: he left so abruptly because of having stuff to do, or he's able to hide his feelings to the point he was able to just. Straight up lie to Sab even with the shock from seeing her as a frog.`
`Given what I witnessed yesterday, I'd lean towards the first, with a slight tinge of awkwardness perhaps.`
At that she smiled and let out a giggle. `”When he told me he think’s I’m attractive he was squirming. I’m even surprised he let me snuggle up with him to watch the stars.”`
`Yeah, I very much doubt the second option with that. In theory it'd be possible if he were incredibly manipulative, but in practise, with all the stuff he's helping with?`
`It's gotta be just business and slash or awkwardness. Or trying to not worry you with 'whoops you woke up sleeping next to someone in an unfamiliar place' sort of thing.`
`”If it’s that man, I don’t care where it is…”` She now sounded a bit more dreamy. `”I really want to ask him…”` she trailed off, then sighed and pulled up the sheets.

`'s far as I know, he went to go rest after the whole Noir thing. I could look for him, but I'm not sure where he'd be, and it'd be... possibly slightly counterproductive for me to just burst into people's airships without being able to explain myself. Even invisibly.`
`”No. I’ll hopefully see him soon. Maybe…”` She bit down hard on her lower lip. `”Stop it, Secel. He won’t yet.”`
`You need anything else? I meant to go stretch my wings, but stretching my brain works well enough.`
She gave a small shrug. `”If you see Sabrine, give her a hug for me. I… might get some shut eye.”` She then giggled a little. `”I don’t feel like I need it, but oh well.”`

`Got it. Been nice to be able to actually talk without pain - Sab doesn't understand Infernal, and my Common is scrambled, I can just about get my point across telepathically, but it's hell -` they grin slightly `- on the head.`
`At least she said it should only last a few days. Something about pact transitioning supposed to separate us from some eldritch entity. So it's worth it, just gotta deal with it for a few days.`
`”Don’t push yourself. If you need me, I could act as a translator.”` She then curled up a bit in the sheets. `”After i finish my nap, of course.”`
`'Course.` they laugh to themselves. `Funny how life goes. My first purpose is to relay for Sab and now I need someone relaying for me. I'll let ya sleep now.`
She smiled and patted their head. `”Take care, and don’t forget that hug.”` She then settled in, and closed her eyes for a nap that quickly transformed into a long rest.
?longrest

Kukudh transforms back into the three-winged pigeon, and flies out, back to circling <#863362543585329162> for a while.
She snaps awake. Her eyes darting around, and.. breathing a sigh of relief she sat up. It wasn’t happening again. Getting up, she headed outside to get some fresh air and walk around the port.

Pulling her way onto *The Strix*, Secel couldn't do anything but cry. She rolled over, her eyes looking at the ceiling. She felt... pain. Pain ripping at her heart. Pain causing her to want to rip it out and throw it off the dock just to no longer feel the pain. The connection she thought they shared... nothing but her own imaginings. Nothing but a fantasy she had worked up in her own head to fill a void she didn't know existed.

Trying to stand up, she took a few steps before falling again. She felt too weak to stand, too weak to even get up. Her love for him... a love she thought he shared with her... faded in her heart. Not all the way, but... well, it was close. She tried to get up once again.

Again, she only made it a few steps. This time she screamed. She screamed out a tortured yell of loss, a yell of hatred at love and all it represented, a yell of damnation of the feelings that followed love. She pushed herself up once more, and staggered forward...

Before collapsing again. This time, she landed full on her face. She clutched at her head, new tears from this pain trickling from her eyes. She felt like... like nothing mattered anymore. That her whole world was lost. She wondered how everything couldn't see that the world was ending. She couldn't understand how life went on like it does. She didn't even bother standing. 

Soon she dragged herself into her room. She tried to pull herself up, fighting with her failing body to pull herself into the comforting familiarity of her bed... but she couldn't. Now, more than ever, she wanted him. She wanted to be in his arms. She wanted to be close to him. She wanted...

She wanted to kiss him. She wanted a feeling of love with him that was shared. She wanted something... she realized might never happen. Those images of waking up with him, his arms around her and planting a loving kiss on her cheek, rays of sunshine making him even more like everything she wanted.. those images of them by a fire on a cold winter's 
-

night, bundled tightly in a blanket, drinking warm drinks late into the night, only to fall asleep.. those images of walking in meadows, a warm sun lighting the landscape, birds singing love songs as they passed by, setting the mood for him to spin her around and pull her in close.. Everything she wanted.... now no longer an option.

She curled up, quietly humming to herself. She hummed a sad song. A song about the end of the world.. Her world.. because he didn’t love her, because he didn’t care about her, because he said goodbye. In truth, he does love her, he does care about her, and he hadn’t said goodbye to her. But she didn’t know that. She only knew she had loved him when they first met. She didn’t know he did as well. She only knew her feelings had grown for him. She didn’t know his own feelings had grown for her. She, like him, didn’t know what the feeling was at first… but now, they did. But, only she knew about her own feelings.

She didn’t know that he did love her, and wanted to keep her safe, just like everyone who lives in Empire City. But.. even now, she didn’t even think he was capable of such feelings. She thought he was so devoted to Athena that… that… that he didn’t see what she saw. She then slammed her head against her bed frame, cursing herself for blaming Athena for her own failures, for her own issues, for her own wants and desires… for her own sins. But, this was simply her being young, full of life and love, and wanting someone to share it with… 

But, now… now she would never get that chance. She believed she had blown her one chance at having a life she so desperately wanted. She thought she had squandered away her only chance at happiness with someone she truly cared for. The only person outside of her family she had ever had love her like she loves them. Someone she wanted to live out her days with, to grow old and grey with, to walk into the Heavens with, hand and hand, to Athena’s side to live forever more. Someone… she would love 
-

until the end and beyond. Come hell or high water, come death and destruction, come everlasting blackness. She wanted to love him as much as ever… But, she couldn’t see it happening now. But, unknown to her is the future. 

Soon, she fell asleep, and prayed to Athena that she would sleep in blackness tonight. She didn’t want to dream. It would only cause more pain, especially if it involved Johnathan, her one true love...

She slowly woke up, the pain only having lessened slightly. Pushing herself up, she got to her feet. At least she could stand up now. Similar to a child taking their first steps, she slowly began to walk, fearing collapsing again... but her legs remained firm as she walked. Silently, she sat on the bed. 

"Johnathan... I know you can't hear me..." She began, then paused. Her grip found her bed and clamped down. "Johnathan.. I love you.. more than you might ever know..." Another pause. "I never thought I would be able to find love, but.. then I met you. You opened something in my heart, and... for the first time, I felt like I belonged to something..." A slightly longer pause. "You are the love of my life... and now I might never see you again..."

She then fought back the urge to cry. She fought back the urge to scream. She fought back the tidal wave of emotions wanting to lash out upon the world. She simply bottled it up, and went about her day.
There is a knocking sound.
She debated being quiet, but sighed. "Who is it?" she called out.
"It Willow! Well, you knew me as Evelyn."
"I brought cookies!"
"Come in." She finished folding up a set of clothes and putting it away.
A light blue elf enters, slightly taller than Evelyn. The face is the same.
She is carrying a large platter of peanut butter cookies.
She smiled at the sight. "Looks delicious. What's the occasion?"
"I just felt like it! Besides, I wanted to check on you. Are you doing alright?"
She forced a nod. "Yeah. I'm doing fine. How about yourself?" As she spoke, she picked up one of the cookies and sniffed it. "Mmmm..."
"I'm doing ok."
"Are you sure you're doing fine? You don't seem like it."
"Y-yeah. Just.. busy." She took a bite of the cookie and melted a little on her legs. "This tastes amazing. Thank you."
Willow sets the platter down.
"Have you met that Johnathan fellow yet? He seemed like a religious type, like you."
She blushed a little, nodding. "We have.." She then took another bite.
"Oooooh, you've *met* huh" Willow says, noticing the blush.
"I figured you two would make good 'friends'."
Secel shot a small glare her way. "And just what is that supposed to mean?"
"Oh nothing..." she gives a little smirk.
"I'm serious Willow. Spit it out." She finished her first cookie. "What do you mean by 'friends'?"
"I saw how you blushed when I said his name. How long have you had feelings for him?"
“I don’t.” But it was obvious to anyone that she only blushed more. Probably thinking about him.
"Come on, you can tell me."
"I'll keep it a secret."
(i'll be right back)
She let out a small sigh, and reached for another cookie. “Since we met. Since I learned he didn’t hate me. Since…” She trailed off. Almost on instinct she shrunk a little.
(alright, I'm back)
"Well, why don't we discuss this in a little bit over some drinks at <#851195363888201749>."
"Sure. I wouldn't be against it." She smiled, then took a bite of the cookie in her hands.
"Alright, meet me there. I have a stop to make before I get there."
"Actually, lets walk to Hampstead together. My business is there, so once we get there, I'll head to where I need to go, then I'll meet you at the bar."
"Sure thing." She got up and grabbed some money before making her way back to Willow. "Thanks again for the cookies. They are delicious."
"No problem." she says, and heads to <#851195289850347540>
She follows along.

Walking back into *The Strix, she smiled and sighed. She was in love! Actually in love! Making her way to her room, she changed clothes and ate a now cold cookie, but she didn't mind. Then, she picked up a few of her small personal belongs and the cookies, and made her way back to *The Sapper*
She drops off her newly bought items before picking up her sleeping gown and a new set of clothes. Changing, into the gown, she headed to *The Sapper*.

She slams the door and sits against it, pulling her knees up to her chest. “What did I do?” She.. whimpered out. Then even louder: “What have I done?!”

She then grabbed hold of her necklace tightly. “Athena, strong and beautiful, Ancient Warrior, come enwrapped in your winged power... I know you blessed us… but.. I…” She tried hard to keep her voice steady. “I.. I didn’t *do it* with him… but I..” She went quiet. “I just felt… I felt safe with him…” 

She then got up, grasping the necklace with both hands. “Athena, wise and powerful daughter of Zeus and Metis, forgive me. I gave into Aphrodite’s temptations. I…” She began tearing up. “Athena, grant me guidance. Grant me strength. Grant me… grant me a sign.”

She then sighed, and walked back to her room. “Johnathan… oh Johnathan… I’m sorry…” She then began cleaning up *The Strix*.
*On silent wings, a barn owl comes to rest on the bow of the Strix...*
She eventually made it to the bow of the ship and spots the owl. “Hello there.”

*The Owl stares deep into Secel's eyes, it's own eyes filled with wisdom. It speaks five words.* "𝔹𝕖 𝕒𝕥 𝕡𝕖𝕒𝕔𝕖 𝕝𝕚𝕥𝕥𝕝𝕖 𝕠𝕟𝕖."
*The Owl remains a few moments longer, and then flies off, vanishing into the starlit sky.*
She watches the owl fly off. Then… she nods. “Yes, Athena.” She says before returning to cleaning her ship.
Eventually she finishes up. Taking one final look at the sky, she made her way to bed.
